reason: Separate deterministic pull-request metadata validation from trusted GitHub Projects v2 provider reconciliation. Pull requests now validate policy, tests, and explicit Development linkage without manufacturing Projects v2 authority; scheduled, push, issue, release, repository-dispatch, and explicit manual lanes retain fail-closed provider reconciliation with the dedicated credential.

changes.reason: Prevent unrelated pull requests from executing Projects v2 mutations with unavailable provider scope while preserving an exact, deterministic PR metadata gate and separately fail-closed trusted provider lanes.

successors: PentaPM trusted Projects v2 reconciliation lane

exclusions: No GitHub Projects v2 PASS is claimed when the credential lacks provider authority.
No branch protection, required check, milestone, project membership, issue, pull request, release, deployment, payment, or entitlement authority is weakened or manufactured.
No secret value is read, logged, rotated, or changed.
Trusted provider reconciliation remains independently fail-closed and receipt-producing.
